title: Villars face graft complaints over PrimeWater contracts | The wRap
summary: Today’s headlines: The Villars, School shooting, West Philippine Sea

blocks.text: Today’s headlines: The Villars, School shooting, West Philippine Sea
Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Villar family faces graft complaints over PrimeWater contracts

blocks.text: Graft complaints are now pending against members of the Villar family due to allegations related to PrimeWater Infrastructure Corporation. This, as confirmed by the Office of the Ombudsman.

items: At least 3 dead, 6 wounded in South Cotabato school shooting

blocks.text: At least three children are killed and six others wounded after a minor opened fire at Banga National High School in South Cotabato, as confirmed by Governor Reynaldo Tamayo Jr.

items: Philippines still among top countries in bullying – PISA 2025

blocks.text: The Philippines sees a lower bullying rate in 2025 but it still has one of the highest rates among participating countries.

items: ‘Intentional ramming’: China Coast Guard damages Philippine ship in West PH Sea

blocks.text: A Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources vessel sustains damage to its metal stanchions and supports, deck fixtures and equipment, and main railings, after being rammed by a China Coast Guard ship.

items: UN mission finds US war crimes, Iran crimes against humanity

blocks.text: A UN fact-finding mission on Iran says, two U.S. military strikes in Iran constituted war crimes. It says it had reasonable grounds to believe the U.S. was behind the strikes on a school and sports facility in Iran in February. – Rappler.com
